name: Joyful Embodied
summary: Joyful Embodied is a robotics company founded in Fuzhou, China, in 2025. It develops embodied intelligence systems spanning robot hardware, models and data collection, and provides deployment and maintenance services for industrial, commercial, education and research applications. Its own product range includes the FORTIS W1 wheeled humanoid. The company also distributes ecosystem partner robots, which are listed separately from its self-developed products on its website. Joyful Embodied is headquartered in Fuzhou Software Park and has branches in Beijing and Nanchang.
